And the Chaldeans answered the king in Syriac,
Tell the dream to your servants,

And in answer, the king said to the Chaldeans,
Sermo recessit a me: nisi indicaveritis mihi somnium,
“The memory of it has slipped away from me. Unless you reveal the dream to me,
and its meaning, you will be put to death,
and your houses will be confiscated.
Si autem somnium, et conjecturam ejus narraveritis, præmia,
But if you explain the dream and its meaning,
et dona, et honorem multum accipietis a me.
you will receive from me rewards, and gifts,
Therefore, reveal to me the dream and its interpretation.”
“Let the king tell the dream to his servants,
and we will reveal its interpretation.”
Certe novi quod tempus redimitis, scientes quod recesserit a me sermo.
“I am certain that you are stalling for time because you know that the memory of it has slipped away from me.
Si ergo somnium non indicaveritis mihi,
Therefore, if you do not reveal to me the dream,
una est de vobis sententia, quod interpretationem quoque fallacem,
there is only one conclusion to be reached about you, that the interpretation is likewise false,
ut loquamini mihi donec tempus pertranseat.
so as to speak before me until the time passes away.
And so, tell me the dream,
ut sciam quod interpretationem quoque ejus veram loquamini.
so that I will also know that the interpretation that you tell me is likewise true.”
Then the Chaldeans answered before the king,
“There is no man on earth who can accomplish your word,
sed neque regum quisquam magnus et potens verbum hujuscemodi sciscitatur ab omni ariolo,
asked for an answer of this kind from every seer,
For the answer that you seek, O king,
nec reperietur quisquam qui indicet illum in conspectu regis,
Neither can anyone be found who can reveal it in the sight of the king,
quorum non est cum hominibus conversatio.
whose conversation is not with men.”

the wise men were put to death;
and Daniel and his companions were sought,
Tunc Daniel requisivit de lege atque sententia ab Arioch principe militiæ regis, qui egressus fuerat ad interficiendos sapientes Babylonis.
Then Daniel inquired, about the law and the sentence, of Arioch, the general of the king’s army, who had gone forth to execute the wise men of Babylon.

Cum ergo rem indicasset Arioch Danieli,
when Arioch had revealed the matter to Daniel,
Daniel ingressus rogavit regem ut tempus daret sibi ad solutionem indicandam regi.
Daniel went in and asked of the king that he would grant him time to reveal the solution to the king.
And he went into his house and explained the task to Hananiah,
ut quærerent misericordiam a facie Dei cæli super sacramento isto,
so that they would seek mercy before the face of the God of heaven,
et socii ejus cum ceteris sapientibus Babylonis.
and so that Daniel and his companions might not perish with the other wise men of Babylon.
Tunc Danieli mysterium per visionem nocte revelatum est:
Then the secret was revealed to Daniel by a vision in the night.
And Daniel blessed the God of heaven,
Sit nomen Domini benedictum a sæculo et usque in sæculum:
he said, “May the name of the Lord be blessed by the present generation and forever;
quia sapientia et fortitudo ejus sunt.
for wisdom and fortitude are his.
He gives wisdom to those who are wise
and teaching skills to those who understand.
He reveals deep and hidden things,
and he knows what has been established in darkness.
And the light is with him.
For you have given wisdom and fortitude to me,
et nunc ostendisti mihi quæ rogavimus te,
and now you have revealed to me what we asked of you,
for you have uncovered for us the king’s thoughts.”
Post hæc Daniel ingressus ad Arioch,
After this, Daniel went in to Arioch,
quem constituerat rex ut perderet sapientes Babylonis,
whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon,
and he spoke to him in this way,
“Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon.
introduc me in conspectu regis, et solutionem regi narrabo.
Bring me in before the king, and I will explain the solution to the king.”
Tunc Arioch festinus introduxit Danielem ad regem,
Then Arioch quickly brought Daniel to the king,
Inveni hominem de filiis transmigrationis Juda,
“I have found a man of the sons of the transmigration of Judah,
who would announce the solution to the king.”
The king answered and said to Daniel,
Putasne vere potes mihi indicare somnium, quod vidi, et interpretationem ejus?
“Do you really think that you can reveal to me the dream that I saw and its interpretation?”
and the soothsayers are unable to reveal to the king.
sed est Deus in cælo revelans mysteria,
But there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries,
quæ ventura sunt in novissimis temporibus.
what will happen in the latter times.
Your dream and the visions of your head upon your bed,
et visiones capitis tui in cubili tuo hujuscemodi sunt.
And he who reveals secrets showed you what will happen.
To me, likewise, this mystery is revealed,
quæ est in me plus quam in cunctis viventibus, sacramentum hoc revelatum est:
not according to the wisdom that is in me more than in other living things,
sed ut interpretatio regi manifesta fieret,
but so that the interpretation might be made manifest to the king,
and so that you may know the thoughts of your mind.
et ecce quasi statua una grandis:

et statura sublimis stabat contra te,

Hujus statuæ caput ex auro optimo erat,
The head of this statue was of the finest gold,
pectus autem et brachia de argento,
but the breast and the arms were of silver, and further on,
porro venter et femora ex ære,
the belly and the thighs were of brass;
but the shins were of iron,
a certain part of the feet were of iron
and another part were of clay.
And so you looked until a stone was broken off without hands from a mountain,
donec abscissus est lapis de monte sine manibus:
and it struck the statue on its feet,
et percussit statuam in pedibus ejus ferreis et fictilibus,
which were of iron and clay,
et aurum, et redacta quasi in favillam æstivæ areæ, quæ rapta sunt vento,
and the gold were crushed together and diminished like the ashes of a summer courtyard,
nullusque locus inventus est eis: lapis autem,
and they were quickly taken away by the wind,
and no place was found for them;
factus est mons magnus, et implevit universam terram.
but the stone that struck the statue became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

and the God of heaven has given to you a kingdom,
and all the places wherein the sons of men
and the beasts of the field dwell.

volucres quoque cæli dedit in manu tua,
and he has placed all things under your realm.
et sub ditione tua universa constituit:
you are the head of gold.
Et post te consurget regnum aliud minus te argenteum:
And after you, another kingdom will rise up, inferior to you,
of silver, and another third kingdom of brass,
which will rule over the whole world.
Et regnum quartum erit velut ferrum:

part of the kingdom will be strong
Quod autem vidisti ferrum mistum testæ ex luto,

In diebus autem regnorum illorum suscitabit Deus cæli regnum,

quod de monte abscissus est lapis sine manibus,

quoniam tu potuisti aperire hoc sacramentum.

ipse autem Daniel erat in foribus regis.
